_readme: Game mode defaults. Do not edit this file: an update replaces it. Copy it to 09-game-mode.json beside it and edit that copy; game mode reads yours first. Games are matched by exact process name (the game's own exe, not its launcher). Every entry is opt-in: set enabled to true to use it. Anti-cheat, Windows system processes and services, Defender, and anything on your game list are refused whatever this file says.

uploadCaps._note: Caps upload only. Nothing is stopped and no sync is interrupted.

stopProcesses.name: Docker Desktop
stopProcesses._note: Example. Asked to close; restarted after the game.

stopProcesses.name: ollama
stopProcesses._note: Example. Frees GPU memory held by a local model; Ollama starts again when something uses it.

stopServices.name: com.docker.service
stopServices._note: Example. Started again after the game.
